ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low ratio; over 95% of visible ventral surface consists of low-intensity dark pixels, with high-intensity pixels restricted to lateral tips and minor surface speckling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark uniform field across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white pixel clusters are isolated at the extreme lateral margins of both the left and right lobes. Minimal high-contrast mottling is observed in the central and medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees and a standard depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations visible along the distal half of the right lobe trailing edge. The left lobe exhibits more moderate, lower-amplitude waves with a few distinct small notches.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward trajectory from the median notch towards the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast, irregular textured clusters (barnacle colonies) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of calcified organisms on the outer edges of the fluke. Small, scattered white circular pixel clusters are visible on the right lobe, likely representing focal depigmentation or old scars.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly uniform, near-total dark pigmentation of the ventral surface, which is a significant identifying characteristic relative to typical mottling patterns.
